name: TEMPLATE - Relatorio Diario Google Ads para WhatsApp

parameters.content:
## TEMPLATE - Relatorio Diario Google Ads para WhatsApp

### How it works

This workflow runs on a schedule, queries the Google Ads API to list accessible client accounts, then fetches daily performance metrics for those accounts. It aggregates the returned metrics, formats a daily summary message, and sends the report to WhatsApp through an HTTP endpoint such as Evolution API.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger with the desired daily run time and timezone.
- Set up Google Ads API access, including OAuth credentials, developer token, manager/customer IDs, and the GAQL queries used by the HTTP Request nodes.
- Verify the JavaScript code nodes match the response structure returned by the Google Ads API and the metrics you want to report.
- Configure the WhatsApp HTTP endpoint URL, authentication headers, recipient number, and payload format for your Evolution API or equivalent provider.

### Customization

Adjust the GAQL queries and JavaScript aggregation logic to change which accounts, campaigns, or metrics are included, and edit the final message template to match your preferred WhatsApp report format.

## Schedule and list accounts

Starts the workflow on a schedule, calls Google Ads to retrieve customer/client accounts, and prepares the account list for metric collection.

## Fetch metrics and send

Requests daily Google Ads metrics, aggregates and formats the results into a WhatsApp-ready report, then posts it to the configured WhatsApp endpoint.
